name: spinel-lsp-client
description: Runs spinel-lsp for Ruby files: spinel's diagnostics, hover types, inlay hints and fast/slow lenses.

spinel.lsp.command.description: The command that runs spinel-lsp, e.g. ["ruby", "/path/to/spinel-ide/tools/spinel-lsp.rb"] or ["/path/to/spinel-lsp"]. Empty runs this extension's own copy under ruby.

spinel.compiler.description: The spinel binary the server runs ($SPINEL). Empty means `spinel` on PATH.
